own_solution.law: a = (m2 - m1) g / (m1 + m2 + I/R^2), with I = M R^2/2 for a uniform disc
assumptions: pulley is a uniform solid disc (authors' assumption, absent from the item text)

defect_reasons.missing_assumption: The authors' certified answers rely on 'the pulley is a uniform solid disc', which appears only in their assumptions and inputs and nowhere in the item text; a thin-hoop pulley gives 1.96 m/s^2 instead of 2.178 m/s^2, so the item has no unique answer as written.

counterexamples: Hoop pulley (I = MR^2): base a = 19.6/10 = 1.96 m/s^2; with the 0.8 kg block attached to the left block a = 11.76/10.8 = 1.089 m/s^2; certified values are 2.17778 and 1.2.
notes: Agrees with pass 1. Under the authors' disc assumption all certified answers check: q = 0.4 kg gives 1.6(9.8)/9.4 = 1.66809; q = 0.8 kg gives 11.76/9.8 = 1.2; q = 1.2 kg gives 7.84/10.2 = 0.768627 m/s^2. The K regime is right: the larger tension is the right-hand one, 5(9.8 - 2.178) = 38.1 N, below every listed rating (120, 200, 300 N). The radius cancels for any fixed pulley shape, so the C claims hold. Minimal pairs T7D27/T59AF and TF5D9/T5F33 state the same 0.8 kg and differ only in attachment. answer_correct is true only conditionally on the unstated disc model; the item fails admission rule 1 because that model is not stated.
